overviewHtml:
Engineers who track work in Linear should not have to watch Dynatrace for incidents. This connector keeps both sides in sync.

What you get

  • Linear issue created or updated whenever a Dynatrace problem fires
  • Two-way comment sync between Dynatrace and Linear
  • Loop prevention with tagged comments and hidden markers
  • One connection per Linear team, managed from the app
setupHtml:
Linear Connector for Dynatrace Workflows is available as a Dynatrace app to all customers upon request.

  1. Linear Connector for Dynatrace Workflows is delivered via a Hub subscription. Email community-apps@dynatrace.com with your account name and tenant ID, as described here.
  2. We'll process your request and send instructions for subscribing to the channel and installing the app.
  3. After installation, open the app from the Dynatrace App Launcher to manage connections and import workflow templates.
getStartedHtml:
1. Request the Hub subscription by emailing the community apps team
  2. Install the app and create a connection per Linear team
  3. Import the workflow templates
